response.justification: While Bogdan demonstrates strong software engineering fundamentals and excellent communication skills across 20 years of experience, he does not meet the mandatory requirements for this role. He has only ~6 months of professional C++ experience (versus the required 5–10 years), no demonstrated Windows platform expertise, and lacks any capital markets, fixed income, derivatives, or investment banking domain knowledge. The role requires specific technical depth in C++/Windows that this candidate cannot provide despite their general seniority.
strengths: Exceptional software engineering craftsmanship with 20 years of experience and demonstrated ability to lead technical initiatives at staff level
Strong communication and mentoring abilities, evidenced by conference talks, workshop creation, and active community contributions
Solid CI/CD pipeline and DevOps knowledge with hands-on experience in automation, GitLab, Docker, and infrastructure setup
concerns: Critical C++ experience gap: only ~6 months of professional C++ (National Instruments) versus the mandatory 5–10 years required
No demonstrated expertise with Windows platform development, which is an explicit mandatory requirement for the role
Completely lacking domain expertise in capital markets, fixed income, derivatives, or investment banking (only tangential investment experience at RIDE Capital)

key_factors.factor: C++ experience severely insufficient (6 months vs. 5–10 years required)
No capital markets or financial services domain expertise
